table.name: cruise: maf feedforward
table.description:
Role in cruise logic
When the cruise controller enters "speed acquisition" mode (flag 0x2000000 in obd_ii_cruise_status), it uses this table to know the expected steady-state airflow at the target speed. It then ramps u16_flow_10mg_s_400014b0 (the working MAF setpoint) down toward that target, with a proportional blend when the vehicle is still below the target speed (lines 51007–51027). Once the actual MAF drops below the feedforward target, the flag clears and the PID takes over.
This is a classic feedforward / open-loop preload for cruise control — avoids overshoot by starting from a physically-motivated airflow estimate rather than relying purely on feedback.
